solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: See odd perennials sprouting

indicators.note: plants sprouting push out in new shapes, so these letters grow into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Look at those unusual plants that come back every year, now putting out shoots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a command to look, but it is the noun: a bishop's diocese, here the Church of England's diocese of Ripon and Leeds in Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: A see is a bishop's diocese, and this was the name of a Yorkshire diocese.

clue.text: One has a job to discover the facts

definitions.text: One has a job to discover the facts

parts.words: One has a job to discover the facts
parts.note: read plainly, someone employed to find things out: a person paid to investigate and study

explanation.definitionFit: Someone employed in investigation whose occupation is finding out facts through study.

clue.text: Philosopher left a shirt in river

indicators.note: in says the left, a and shirt pieces sit inside the river

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
T as in T-shirt

explanation.surface: A thinker dumped his shirt in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Plato was the ancient Greek philosopher, pupil of Socrates.

clue.text: Forced to make a decision about Daniel not at university

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of the name are rearranged

parts.note: a student who has gone down has left university

explanation.surface: Daniel, away from college, was pushed into choosing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns DANIEL into NAILED; being 'down' from university is the British idiom for having left or being on vacation from it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone nailed down has been pinned to a firm commitment, made to settle on a choice.

clue.text: Baffle no more

definitions.meaning: to baffle is to perplex someone completely
the Latin phrase ... means 'no further', the state of being unable to go on

explanation.definitionFit: To nonplus someone leaves them at a point where they can go no further, utterly perplexed.

clue.text: Fatter individual entering pantry

indicators.note: entering puts the individual piece inside the pantry

parts.note: a larder is a pantry or food store
I, the single person, or the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A plumper person goes into the food cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Lardier means having more lard, so plumper or more fatty.

clue.text: Semi-continental kangaroo

definitions.meaning: the prefix meaning European, the first half of a word describing the Continent
a large Australian kangaroo, also called a wallaroo

explanation.definitionFit: The euro is a species of wallaroo, and euro- is the prefix for things European, or Continental.

clue.text: Gleam sent out when divided into parts

indicators.note: out signals the letters being put out of their order

explanation.surface: A glimmer of light goes out as it is split up.
explanation.definitionFit: Segmental describes something made up of segments, so split into sections.

clue.text: It's the best illustration one could have

definitions.text: It's the best illustration one could have

parts.words: It's the best illustration one could have
parts.note: reads like praise of a picture, but means the ideal instance of something

explanation.definitionFit: An ideal model or flawless instance is the finest specimen to show a point.

clue.text: Merchant, stop expressing reluctance

parts.note: a station is a stopping place for trains or buses
er is the hesitant sound of someone unwilling

explanation.surface: A trader is told to cease voicing his unwillingness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stop' reads as a command, but it is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A stationer was originally a bookseller or merchant, now one selling writing materials.

clue.text: Scoundrel to go wrong way in Parisian street

indicators.note: in places the turned piece inside the street

parts.note: rue is French for street

indicators.note: going the wrong way means the word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A villain takes a wrong turn down a road in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue is a dishonest rascal, a synonym for scoundrel.

clue.text: A party about love

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A celebration all about romance.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to love them deeply, a synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Lake in front of dry den

indicators.note: in front of puts the lake ahead of the next piece

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake
to air laundry is to dry it

explanation.surface: A dry hideaway stands before a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A lair is an animal's den or hideout.

clue.text: Some more effective barrier

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a barrier works better than the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef is a ridge of rock or coral forming a barrier in the sea.

clue.text: Honest as a grandmaster?

definitions.meaning: open and legitimate, with nothing concealed
a chess master sits over the chessboard while playing

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means open and legitimate, and literally a chess player is over the board.

clue.text: Dance in Hungary as cards collapse

indicators.note: a house of cards collapsing falls into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Hungarian folk dance is under way while a card tower falls.
explanation.definitionFit: The csardas is a Hungarian national folk dance, also spelt czardas.

clue.text: It is mainly between Greece and Turkey

definitions.text: It is mainly between Greece and Turkey

parts.words: It is mainly between Greece and Turkey
parts.note: reads like 'it lies largely between two nations', but 'mainly' hints at the main, an old word for the sea

explanation.definitionFit: This arm of the Mediterranean lies between the Greek mainland and Turkey.

clue.text: Boor removed bloodsucker, say, it's automatic

indicators.note: removed suggests the word is shifted from its form, so its letters are rearranged
say means the word is spoken, giving a twin that sounds the same

parts.note: a tick is a bloodsucking parasite

explanation.surface: A lout got rid of a parasite, all done mechanically.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed' rearranges BOOR to ROBO; 'say' signals TIC, which sounds like the parasite TICK.
explanation.definitionFit: Robotic means behaving like a machine, so mechanical or automatic.

clue.text: Fight for more pay

definitions.meaning: to make war is to fight a campaign
read as a pun, a battle over wages

explanation.definitionFit: To wage war is to fight; read as a phrase it suggests a campaign over earnings.

clue.text: Flowing Polish I study?

parts.note: to rub something is to polish it
to con is an old word for to study

explanation.surface: Is this smooth-running polish something I should examine?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flowing' is a cryptic definition hinting at something that flows, a river: the Rubicon, crossed by Caesar. The question mark admits the stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rubicon is a river in Italy, a flowing stream famously crossed by Julius Caesar.

clue.text: Sin and latitude in south-eastern city

indicators.note: in puts the sin and latitude pieces inside the south-eastern letters

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east
evil is wickedness or sin

explanation.surface: Wickedness and freedom in a city in the south-east.
explanation.definitionFit: Seville is a city in Andalusia, southern Spain.

clue.text: Is turning up at North African country, not Missouri, during windstorm

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word is read from the bottom upwards
not says the Missouri letters are left out

parts.note: Morocco is a country in North-West Africa
MO is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Missouri

explanation.surface: Someone shows up in a North African country, away from Missouri, during a desert storm.
explanation.definitionFit: The sirocco is a hot dusty wind blowing from North Africa across the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Way a Pole goes round

indicators.note: goes round says the pole encloses the a

parts.note: a rod is a pole, as in a fishing rod

explanation.surface: A man from Poland takes a detour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person; it is a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A road is a route or way.

clue.text: Leading Tyrolean put restriction on ski-lift

indicators.note: leading picks out the first letter of the next word

parts.note: a bar is a restriction or prohibition

explanation.surface: An Austrian official bans the use of a mountain lift.
explanation.definitionFit: A T-bar is a ski-lift with T-shaped bars that tow skiers uphill.

clue.text: Arabs transporting port

indicators.note: transporting carries the letters elsewhere, moving them into a new order

explanation.surface: Arabs carrying goods to a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Basra is Iraq's main port, on the Shatt al-Arab.

clue.text: Promises to pay maiden inside coming up from Scandinavian country

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
inside puts the maiden within the promises to pay

parts.note: IOUs are written promises to pay a debt
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: IOUs with a young woman inside rise from a Nordic country.
explanation.walkthrough: IOUS with M inside makes IMOUS, which 'coming up' turns round. A maiden in cricket is an over with no runs scored.
explanation.definitionFit: Suomi is the Finnish name for Finland, often counted as Scandinavian.

clue.text: Long drink first for bird

indicators.note: first places the drink ahead of the long piece

parts.note: tea is a drink
L is an abbreviation for long, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A tall drink comes before anything for the bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long drink' looks like one phrase but splits: L for 'Long' and TEA for 'drink'.
explanation.definitionFit: The teal is a small freshwater duck.

clue.text: Guarantee, after losing rook, to take place as a result

indicators.note: after losing says a letter is taken out

parts.note: to ensure is to guarantee
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A pledge, once a chess piece is lost, comes into force.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow on as a consequence.

clue.text: Old mate with a ring exhibiting self-importance

parts.note: old cock is a dated British term of address for a friend
a hoop is a ring

explanation.surface: An old friend shows off a ring in a boastful way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old cock' is dated British slang for a pal, like 'mate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cock-a-hoop means exultant or boastful, crowing with pride.

clue.text: Everybody early — eventually

parts.note: all means everybody
to arrive in good time is to arrive early

explanation.surface: Everyone turns up before time, in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means at the proper moment in the future, so eventually.
